segments.expected: Her right hand would not close. She had known it would not. She had known it at the table at eleven with the chalk in Perrin's fist, and said it, and Perrin had said wrist, then, and she had said wrist. But a wrist under a pole is not a hand round it, and the head of the Commodore came over the hazel at her and she took it on her left hand and her right wrist and it went down on the right. Pru had the foot. Pru had put her capped fingers round the foot poles, because that was where the foot was. Kiva heard her draw her breath in through her teeth. The Commodore's foot went down on the hazel.
